# Load required libraries
library(EpiModel)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# =============================================================================
# 1. PARAMETERS
# =============================================================================

param_init <- function() {
  params <- list(
    # Population parameters
    initial_pop_size = 1000,
    prob_patient = 0.85,
    
    # Initial status probabilities for patients (must sum to 1)
    prob_status = c(Sp = 0.80, Cp_s = 0.07, Cp_r = 0.05, Ip_s = 0.05, Ip_r = 0.03),
    
    # Transmission parameters
    a = 10,           # Contact rate between patients and HCWs
    b_np = 0.05,      # Transmission probability from HCW to patient
    b_pn = 0.05,      # Transmission probability from patient to HCW
    theta = 0.5,      # Precaution compliance of HCWs
    
    # Strain-specific parameters
    s_b = 0.2,        # Fitness cost of resistance (reduces transmission)
    s_p = 0.3,        # Penalty on treatment efficacy due to resistance
    n = 0.5,          # Penalty on transmission in colonized patients
    
    # Clinical parameters
    x = 0.3,          # Proportion exposed who develop infection directly
    kappa = 0.1,      # Clearance rate of colonization (1/duration)
    m_s = 0.2,        # Probability of developing infection when colonized (MSSA)
    delta_m = 0.5,    # Increment in m_s for MRSA
    
    # Treatment parameters
    psi_s = 0.4,      # Treatment rate for MSSA infection
    psi_r = 0.2,      # Treatment rate for MRSA infection
    iota = 0.7,       # Treatment success probability
    
    # Decontamination parameters
    low = 0.1,        # Decontamination rate with low compliance
    high = 0.9,       # Decontamination rate with high compliance
    
    # Other parameters
    nsteps = 100,     # Number of simulation steps
    seed = 12345      # For reproducibility
  )
  return(params)
}

# =============================================================================
# 2. INITIALIZATION MODULE
# =============================================================================

initialize_icm <- function(dat, at) {
  
  # Get parameters
  initial_pop_size <- get_param(dat, "initial_pop_size")
  prob_patient <- get_param(dat, "prob_patient")
  prob_status <- get_param(dat, "prob_status")
  
  # Set seed for reproducibility
  set.seed(get_param(dat, "seed"))
  
  # Initialize active status (all alive initially)
  active <- rep(1, initial_pop_size)
  
  # Assign types (patient or nurse)
  type <- sample(
    c("patient", "nurse"),
    initial_pop_size,
    replace = TRUE,
    prob = c(prob_patient, 1 - prob_patient)
  )
  
  # Initialize status vector
  status <- rep(NA, initial_pop_size)
  
  # Assign patient statuses
  patients <- which(type == "patient")
  status[patients] <- sample(
    names(prob_status),
    length(patients),
    replace = TRUE,
    prob = prob_status
  )
  
  # Nurses start uncontaminated
  nurses <- which(type == "nurse")
  status[nurses] <- "Un"
  
  # Set attributes
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "active", active)
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "type", type)
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "status", status)
  
  # Record initial counts
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Sp", at, sum(status == "Sp", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cp_s", at, sum(status == "Cp_s", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cp_r", at, sum(status == "Cp_r", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Ip_s", at, sum(status == "Ip_s", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Ip_r", at, sum(status == "Ip_r", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Un", at, sum(status == "Un", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cn_s", at, sum(status == "Cn_s", na.rm = TRUE))
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cn_r", at, sum(status == "Cn_r", na.rm = TRUE))
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. INFECTION MODULE (Patient Infection from Nurses)
# =============================================================================

infection_module <- function(dat, at) {
  
  # Get attributes
  active <- get_attr(dat, "active")
  status <- get_attr(dat, "status")
  type <- get_attr(dat, "type")
  
  # Get parameters
  a <- get_param(dat, "a")
  x <- get_param(dat, "x")
  s_b <- get_param(dat, "s_b")
  b_np <- get_param(dat, "b_np")
  theta <- get_param(dat, "theta")
  
  # Find susceptible patients
  idsElig <- which(active == 1 & type == "patient" & status == "Sp")
  
  # Initialize counters
  nInf_s <- 0
  nInf_r <- 0
  nCol_s <- 0
  nCol_r <- 0
  
  if (length(idsElig) > 0) {
    
    # Calculate contamination pressure from nurses
    total_nurses <- sum(active == 1 & type == "nurse")
    
    if (total_nurses > 0) {
      Cn_s <- sum(active == 1 & type == "nurse" & status == "Cn_s")
      Cn_r <- sum(active == 1 & type == "nurse" & status == "Cn_r")
      
      # Force of infection
      beta_np_s <- a * b_np * (1 - theta) * Cn_s / total_nurses
      beta_np_r <- a * b_np * (1 - theta) * (1 - s_b) * Cn_r / total_nurses
      
      # Probabilities
      probInf_s <- 1 - exp(-beta_np_s)
      probInf_r <- 1 - exp(-beta_np_r)
      
      # Simulate infections
      inf_s <- rbinom(length(idsElig), 1, probInf_s)
      inf_r <- rbinom(length(idsElig), 1, probInf_r)
      
      # Process infections
      for (i in seq_along(idsElig)) {
        id <- idsElig[i]
        
        # MSSA infection
        if (inf_s[i] == 1 && inf_r[i] == 0) {
          if (runif(1) < x) {
            status[id] <- "Ip_s"
            nInf_s <- nInf_s + 1
          } else {
            status[id] <- "Cp_s"
            nCol_s <- nCol_s + 1
          }
        }
        
        # MRSA infection
        if (inf_r[i] == 1 && inf_s[i] == 0) {
          if (runif(1) < x) {
            status[id] <- "Ip_r"
            nInf_r <- nInf_r + 1
          } else {
            status[id] <- "Cp_r"
            nCol_r <- nCol_r + 1
          }
        }
        
        # If both infections occur, prioritize MRSA (more severe)
        if (inf_s[i] == 1 && inf_r[i] == 1) {
          if (runif(1) < x) {
            status[id] <- "Ip_r"
            nInf_r <- nInf_r + 1
          } else {
            status[id] <- "Cp_r"
            nCol_r <- nCol_r + 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Update attributes
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "status", status)
  
  # Record flows
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "np.inf.flow.s", at, nInf_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "np.inf.flow.r", at, nInf_r)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "np.col.flow.s", at, nCol_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "np.col.flow.r", at, nCol_r)
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# 4. PROGRESSION MODULE (Colonization to Infection)
# =============================================================================

progression_module <- function(dat, at) {
  
  # Get attributes
  active <- get_attr(dat, "active")
  status <- get_attr(dat, "status")
  
  # Get parameters
  kappa <- get_param(dat, "kappa")
  m_s <- get_param(dat, "m_s")
  delta_m <- get_param(dat, "delta_m")
  
  # Find colonized patients
  idsElig_s <- which(active == 1 & status == "Cp_s")
  idsElig_r <- which(active == 1 & status == "Cp_r")
  
  # Progression rates
  gamma_s <- kappa * m_s
  gamma_r <- kappa * m_s * (1 + delta_m)
  
  # Initialize counters
  nProg_s <- 0
  nProg_r <- 0
  
  # MSSA progression
  if (length(idsElig_s) > 0) {
    prog_s <- rbinom(length(idsElig_s), 1, gamma_s)
    nProg_s <- sum(prog_s)
    if (nProg_s > 0) {
      status[idsElig_s[which(prog_s == 1)]] <- "Ip_s"
    }
  }
  
  # MRSA progression
  if (length(idsElig_r) > 0) {
    prog_r <- rbinom(length(idsElig_r), 1, gamma_r)
    nProg_r <- sum(prog_r)
    if (nProg_r > 0) {
      status[idsElig_r[which(prog_r == 1)]] <- "Ip_r"
    }
  }
  
  # Update attributes
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "status", status)
  
  # Record flows
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "prog.flow.s", at, nProg_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "prog.flow.r", at, nProg_r)
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# 5. TREATMENT MODULE
# =============================================================================

treatment_module <- function(dat, at) {
  
  # Get attributes
  active <- get_attr(dat, "active")
  status <- get_attr(dat, "status")
  
  # Get parameters
  psi_s <- get_param(dat, "psi_s")
  psi_r <- get_param(dat, "psi_r")
  iota <- get_param(dat, "iota")
  s_p <- get_param(dat, "s_p")
  
  # Find infected patients
  idsElig_s <- which(active == 1 & status == "Ip_s")
  idsElig_r <- which(active == 1 & status == "Ip_r")
  
  # Initialize counters
  nTreat_s <- 0
  nTreat_r <- 0
  nRecov_s <- 0
  nRecov_r <- 0
  nDischarge <- 0
  
  # MSSA treatment
  if (length(idsElig_s) > 0) {
    treat_s <- rbinom(length(idsElig_s), 1, psi_s)
    nTreat_s <- sum(treat_s)
    
    if (nTreat_s > 0) {
      treated_s <- idsElig_s[which(treat_s == 1)]
      recover <- rbinom(nTreat_s, 1, iota)
      nRecov_s <- sum(recover)
      
      status[treated_s[which(recover == 1)]] <- "Sp"
      
      # Treatment failure -> discharge/death
      active[treated_s[which(recover == 0)]] <- 0
      nDischarge <- nDischarge + sum(recover == 0)
    }
  }
  
  # MRSA treatment
  if (length(idsElig_r) > 0) {
    treat_r <- rbinom(length(idsElig_r), 1, psi_r)
    nTreat_r <- sum(treat_r)
    
    if (nTreat_r > 0) {
      treated_r <- idsElig_r[which(treat_r == 1)]
      recover <- rbinom(nTreat_r, 1, iota * (1 - s_p))
      nRecov_r <- sum(recover)
      
      status[treated_r[which(recover == 1)]] <- "Sp"
      
      # Treatment failure -> discharge/death
      active[treated_r[which(recover == 0)]] <- 0
      nDischarge <- nDischarge + sum(recover == 0)
    }
  }
  
  # Update attributes
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "status", status)
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "active", active)
  
  # Record flows
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "treat.flow.s", at, nTreat_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "treat.flow.r", at, nTreat_r)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "recov.flow.s", at, nRecov_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "recov.flow.r", at, nRecov_r)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "discharge.flow", at, nDischarge)
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# 6. NURSE CONTAMINATION MODULE
# =============================================================================

nurse_contamination_module <- function(dat, at) {
  
  # Get attributes
  active <- get_attr(dat, "active")
  status <- get_attr(dat, "status")
  type <- get_attr(dat, "type")
  
  # Get parameters
  a <- get_param(dat, "a")
  b_pn <- get_param(dat, "b_pn")
  theta <- get_param(dat, "theta")
  s_b <- get_param(dat, "s_b")
  n <- get_param(dat, "n")
  
  # Find uncontaminated nurses
  idsElig <- which(active == 1 & type == "nurse" & status == "Un")
  
  # Initialize counters
  nContam_s <- 0
  nContam_r <- 0
  
  if (length(idsElig) > 0) {
    
    # Get patient counts
    Np <- sum(active == 1 & type == "patient")
    
    if (Np > 0) {
      Cp_s <- sum(active == 1 & status == "Cp_s")
      Ip_s <- sum(active == 1 & status == "Ip_s")
      Cp_r <- sum(active == 1 & status == "Cp_r")
      Ip_r <- sum(active == 1 & status == "Ip_r")
      
      # Contact rate scaling
      phi <- Np / length(idsElig)
      
      # Force of contamination
      beta_pn_s <- a * b_pn * (1 - theta) * phi * ((n * Cp_s + Ip_s) / Np)
      beta_pn_r <- a * b_pn * (1 - theta) * phi * (1 - s_b) * ((n * Cp_r + Ip_r) / Np)
      
      # Probabilities
      probCtm_s <- 1 - exp(-beta_pn_s)
      probCtm_r <- 1 - exp(-beta_pn_r)
      
      # Simulate contamination
      contam_s <- rbinom(length(idsElig), 1, probCtm_s)
      contam_r <- rbinom(length(idsElig), 1, probCtm_r)
      
      # Process contamination
      for (i in seq_along(idsElig)) {
        id <- idsElig[i]
        
        # MSSA contamination
        if (contam_s[i] == 1 && contam_r[i] == 0) {
          status[id] <- "Cn_s"
          nContam_s <- nContam_s + 1
        }
        
        # MRSA contamination
        if (contam_r[i] == 1 && contam_s[i] == 0) {
          status[id] <- "Cn_r"
          nContam_r <- nContam_r + 1
        }
        
        # Both - prioritize MRSA
        if (contam_s[i] == 1 && contam_r[i] == 1) {
          status[id] <- "Cn_r"
          nContam_r <- nContam_r + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Update attributes
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "status", status)
  
  # Record flows
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "pn.contam.flow.s", at, nContam_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "pn.contam.flow.r", at, nContam_r)
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# 7. DECONTAMINATION MODULE
# =============================================================================

decontamination_module <- function(dat, at) {
  
  # Get attributes
  active <- get_attr(dat, "active")
  status <- get_attr(dat, "status")
  type <- get_attr(dat, "type")
  
  # Get parameters
  theta <- get_param(dat, "theta")
  low <- get_param(dat, "low")
  high <- get_param(dat, "high")
  
  # Find contaminated nurses
  idsElig_s <- which(active == 1 & type == "nurse" & status == "Cn_s")
  idsElig_r <- which(active == 1 & type == "nurse" & status == "Cn_r")
  
  # Decontamination rate
  delta <- (1 - theta) * low + theta * high
  
  # Initialize counters
  nDecon_s <- 0
  nDecon_r <- 0
  
  # MSSA decontamination
  if (length(idsElig_s) > 0) {
    decon_s <- rbinom(length(idsElig_s), 1, delta)
    nDecon_s <- sum(decon_s)
    if (nDecon_s > 0) {
      status[idsElig_s[which(decon_s == 1)]] <- "Un"
    }
  }
  
  # MRSA decontamination
  if (length(idsElig_r) > 0) {
    decon_r <- rbinom(length(idsElig_r), 1, delta)
    nDecon_r <- sum(decon_r)
    if (nDecon_r > 0) {
      status[idsElig_r[which(decon_r == 1)]] <- "Un"
    }
  }
  
  # Update attributes
  dat <- set_attr(dat, "status", status)
  
  # Record flows
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "decon.flow.s", at, nDecon_s)
  dat <- set_epi(dat, "decon.flow.r", at, nDecon_r)
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS (replace EpiModel's get_attr/set_attr/get_param/set_epi)
# =============================================================================

get_attr <- function(dat, name) dat$attr[[name]]
set_attr <- function(dat, name, value) { dat$attr[[name]] <- value; dat }
get_param <- function(dat, name) dat$param[[name]]

set_epi <- function(dat, name, at, value) {
  if (is.null(dat$epi[[name]])) {
    dat$epi[[name]] <- rep(NA_real_, dat$param$nsteps)
  }
  dat$epi[[name]][at] <- value
  dat
}

# =============================================================================
# SIMULATION WRAPPER (custom loop, no EpiModel icm()/netsim())
# =============================================================================

run_simulation <- function(params = NULL) {
  
  if (is.null(params)) {
    params <- param_init()
  }
  
  # Minimal "dat" object to carry attributes, params, and epi trackers
  dat <- list(
    attr = list(),
    param = params,
    epi = list()
  )
  
  # Initialize population at t = 1
  dat <- initialize_icm(dat, at = 1)
  
  # Run remaining modules for each subsequent time step
  for (at in 2:params$nsteps) {
    dat <- infection_module(dat, at)
    dat <- progression_module(dat, at)
    dat <- treatment_module(dat, at)
    dat <- nurse_contamination_module(dat, at)
    dat <- decontamination_module(dat, at)
    
    # Carry forward cumulative state counts for this step
    status <- get_attr(dat, "status")
    active <- get_attr(dat, "active")
    type   <- get_attr(dat, "type")
    
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Sp",   at, sum(active == 1 & type == "patient" & status == "Sp",   na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cp_s", at, sum(active == 1 & type == "patient" & status == "Cp_s", na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cp_r", at, sum(active == 1 & type == "patient" & status == "Cp_r", na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Ip_s", at, sum(active == 1 & type == "patient" & status == "Ip_s", na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Ip_r", at, sum(active == 1 & type == "patient" & status == "Ip_r", na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Un",   at, sum(active == 1 & type == "nurse"   & status == "Un",   na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cn_s", at, sum(active == 1 & type == "nurse"   & status == "Cn_s", na.rm = TRUE))
    dat <- set_epi(dat, "num.Cn_r", at, sum(active == 1 & type == "nurse"   & status == "Cn_r", na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  
  class(dat) <- "simdat"
  
  return(dat)
}

# =============================================================================
# EXTRACTOR (replaces as.data.frame(sim) from EpiModel)
# =============================================================================

as.data.frame.simdat <- function(dat) {
  epi_df <- as.data.frame(dat$epi)
  epi_df$time <- seq_len(dat$param$nsteps)
  return(epi_df)
}

# =============================================================================
# PLOTTING FUNCTIONS 
# =============================================================================

plot_simulation <- function(sim) {
  
  df <- as.data.frame.simdat(sim)
  
  p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Sp,   color = "Susceptible"),    linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Cp_s, color = "Colonized MSSA"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Cp_r, color = "Colonized MRSA"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Ip_s, color = "Infected MSSA"),  linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Ip_r, color = "Infected MRSA"),  linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Patient States Over Time",
      x = "Time Steps",
      y = "Number of Patients",
      color = "State"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Susceptible" = "#2E86C1",
        "Colonized MSSA" = "#28B463",
        "Colonized MRSA" = "#F39C12",
        "Infected MSSA" = "#E74C3C",
        "Infected MRSA" = "#943126"
      )
    )
  
  p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Un,   color = "Uncontaminated"),     linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Cn_s, color = "Contaminated MSSA"),  linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = num.Cn_r, color = "Contaminated MRSA"),  linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Nurse States Over Time",
      x = "Time Steps",
      y = "Number of Nurses",
      color = "State"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Uncontaminated" = "#2E86C1",
        "Contaminated MSSA" = "#28B463",
        "Contaminated MRSA" = "#F39C12"
      )
    )
  
  library(patchwork)
  combined_plot <- p1 / p2 +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "MSSA/MRSA Transmission Dynamics in Hospital",
      subtitle = "Individual-Based Model Simulation"
    )
  
  print(combined_plot)
  
  return(list(patient_plot = p1, nurse_plot = p2, combined = combined_plot))
}

# =============================================================================
# RUN
# =============================================================================

sim_results <- run_simulation()
plots <- plot_simulation(sim_results)
# =============================================================================
# 10. RUN THE SIMULATION
# =============================================================================

# Run with default parameters
cat("Running simulation...\n")
sim_results <- run_simulation()

# Plot the results
cat("\nGenerating plots...\n")
plots <- plot_simulation(sim_results)

# Display summary statistics

            sum(last_row$num.Sp + last_row$num.Cp_s + last_row$num.Cp_r + 
                  last_row$num.Ip_s + last_row$num.Ip_r),
            sum(last_row$num.Un + last_row$num.Cn_s + last_row$num.Cn_r)))

            100 * (last_row$num.Cp_s + last_row$num.Ip_s) / 
              (last_row$num.Sp + last_row$num.Cp_s + last_row$num.Cp_r + 
                 last_row$num.Ip_s + last_row$num.Ip_r)))

cat(sprintf("Final MRSA prevalence: %.2f%%\n", 
            100 * (last_row$num.Cp_r + last_row$num.Ip_r) / 
              (last_row$num.Sp + last_row$num.Cp_s + last_row$num.Cp_r + 
                 last_row$num.Ip_s + last_row$num.Ip_r)))

# =============================================================================
# 11. SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS EXAMPLE
# =============================================================================

run_sensitivity <- function() {
  
  # Test different compliance levels
  theta_values <- c(0.3, 0.5, 0.7)
  results <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(theta_values)) {
    cat(sprintf("\nRunning simulation with theta = %.1f...\n", theta_values[i]))
    
    params <- param_init()
    params$theta <- theta_values[i]
    params$nsteps <- 50  # Shorter for sensitivity
    
    sim <- run_simulation(params)
    df <- as.data.frame.simdat(sim)   
    results[[i]] <- df
  }
  
  # Plot comparison
  plot_df <- data.frame()
  for (i in seq_along(theta_values)) {
    temp <- results[[i]]
    temp$theta <- theta_values[i]
    plot_df <- rbind(plot_df, temp)
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time, y = num.Ip_s + num.Ip_r, color = factor(theta))) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Effect of HCW Compliance on Total Infections",
      x = "Time Steps",
      y = "Total Infected Patients",
      color = "Compliance (θ)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  print(p)
  
  return(results)
}
